node_8.subject: Carlos Gomez
node_8.description: This is Carlos Gomez's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, Wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, Eat breakfast from 7:30 am to 8:00 am, Attend classes in Classroom 1 from 8:30 am to 12:00 pm, Have lunch from 12:00 pm to 12:30 pm, Write poems in the school courtyard from 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm, Attend afternoon classes in Classroom 1 from 2:30 pm to 4:00 pm, Attempt to communicate with Ayesha Khan about poetry from 4:00 pm to 4:30 pm, Eat dinner at 5:00 pm, Work on his poetry collection from 6:00 pm to 8:00 pm, Relax and listen to music from 8:00 pm to 9:30 pm, Go to bed at 10:00 pm.
